additional_info.subject: Case creation Notes
additional_info.body: we tried to set wiring connection with the following parameter: static ip address: 192.168.0.10 - mask: 255.255.255.0 - gateway: 192.168.0.1 - DNS 8.8.8.8 We need to: 1) establish connection with the backend on router 2 2) have the SIM as failover if the fiber connection is crushing. We made a test connecting the cable connected to the charger to a laptop and we would be able to ping 8.8.8.8, while when we tried to get the same ping via teltonika diagnostic we loose the whole package trasmitted.

additional_info.subject: Notes
additional_info.body:
Need to get the SSH access for this charger and need to check the router configuration remotely
Had discussion on M Teams with RC, the WAN configuration has been changed to wired, but the internet is not working on the router. However, when the LAN cable is connected directly to the laptop, it works.
RC also confirmed that the wired connection is still connected to the router. Check the XF4 settings remotely.
